note: Generated imagery for the Clifton Eye Center glass + layered-depth redesign. Rules: illustrative industry imagery only; never a stand-in for Dr. Deana Clifton, her staff, the office, a patient, a result, a brand or an insurance carrier; no text, numbers, labels, emblems or wordmarks anywhere in frame (every image is reviewed as zoomed native-size crops and Kontext-edited or regenerated if any appear); people are generic illustrative models and clinicians appear only as a white-coat sleeve and hands; alt describes what is depicted, never 'our office' / 'our patient' / 'Dr. Clifton'; decorative layers (backdrops, textures, sprig, lens) carry alt "". Never place a generated eyewear image beside or captioned with a frame-brand, contact-lens-brand or carrier name. Generated images must carry an AI label in file metadata after any re-encode (IPTC trainedAlgorithmicMedia XMP) and are listed in the handoff docs. 16 entries generate (fal calls); 4 slot-fill entries reuse a generated image for a source image that is broken on the live site (no fal call). svc-eyewear-boutique also fills one broken slot via its own fillFor. See docs/IMAGE-PLAN.md.
